overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: two members were not a subcommittee and did not form a quorum, and the claim about consulting the Commission before contacting an engineer was declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged two Commission members discussed sewer service area business outside a noticed meeting, including deciding to contact an engineering firm.
allegations.key_passage: Because Mr. Luck and Mr. Anderson did not constitute a subcommittee subject to the Open Meeting Law, and because the discussion at issue did not occur between or among a quorum of a public body, it did not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Alleged that the two members were obligated to consult the full Commission before contacting the engineering firm.
allegations.key_passage: we note that this allegation, even if true, would not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law and we therefore decline to review it.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
